findings.title: SSR-Unsafe localStorage Access in ThemeToggle Component
findings.description: The toggleTheme function and useEffect hook access localStorage directly without checking if the code is running in a browser environment. This can cause hydration mismatches and runtime errors during server-side rendering.
findings.consequence: Potential hydration warnings, runtime errors during SSR, theme flickering on page load, and possible deployment health check failures on Vercel.
findings.correction: Add typeof window === 'undefined' checks before all localStorage and window API access in both the toggleTheme function and the useEffect hook.
findings.evidence: Lines 17-21: localStorage.setItem called without browser check. Lines 27-28: localStorage.getItem and window.matchMedia called without browser check in useEffect.
findings.triggeringPath: User visits application -> Next.js performs SSR -> ThemeToggle renders -> useEffect executes on mount -> localStorage accessed without guard
